visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with two hands holding a white tube of NARS Light Reflecting Primer on the left and a small beige pump bottle of CANMAKE Moisture & Glow Primer on the right. The hands have neutral-colored nails and are positioned against a bright background of horizontal window blinds. Sunlight filters through the blinds, creating a high-key lighting environment. (2) A young woman with short dark hair and elegant makeup appears, holding the same two products near her face. She wears small hoop earrings, a silver necklace with a circular pendant, and a blue sleeveless top. The background shifts to a shelf filled with various small collectibles and bear-like figurines in a well-lit indoor room. (3) The scene cuts back to a pair of hands holding a rounded SHISEIDO foundation bottle on the left and a tall beige excel foundation tube on the right. The setting returns to the window blinds with bright natural light, emphasizing the textures of the product packaging. (4) The woman reappears, smiling and holding the SHISEIDO and excel products on either side of her face. Her expression is pleasant and confident, showcasing her flawless complexion. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting her features against the background shelf. (5) Two hands hold a round CLINIQUE blush compact on the left and a rectangular Enamor blush compact on the right. The CLINIQUE product has a floral pattern embossed on the powder, while the Enamor has a smooth pink surface. The window blinds provide a consistent backdrop with linear shadows. (6) The woman is shown again, holding the two blush compacts. She tilts her head slightly, maintaining eye contact with the lens. Her blue top and silver jewelry remain consistent throughout the shots, and the room lighting is bright and inviting. (7) Hands hold an ornate, multi-colored Clé de Peau Beauté highlighter palette on the left and a simpler, crystalline CEZANNE highlighter compact on the right. The luxury palette has a gold-trimmed case, while the budget option is in a clear plastic container. The bright sunlight from the window highlights the shimmering textures of the powders. (8) The woman holds the highlighters up to her cheeks, demonstrating where they would be applied. She maintains a warm, engaging expression. The background shelf with the collectibles remains out of focus, keeping the emphasis on the products and her face. (9) The final scene shows hands holding a large dark brown glass Aesop Geranium Leaf Body Cleanser bottle on the left and a smaller brown MUJI Essential Oil Aromatherapy Hand Wash bottle on the right. The setting is the same bright window with blinds, concluding the comparison of premium versus affordable items.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track consists entirely of a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop background track with a consistent tempo of approximately 128 BPM. It features a driving kick drum and bright, pulsing synthesizer pads that provide a rhythmic foundation for the video's rapid visual cuts. There are no human vocals, spoken dialogue, or narration present in the mix. The production is clean and polished, typical of social media content design. The bass frequencies are well-defined, and the upper spectral range is clear, highlighting the electronic textures. The music remains constant throughout the entire 17-second duration without any structural pauses, transient SFX, or acoustic texture shifts, creating a seamless and motivating atmosphere that complements the fast-paced product showcase.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Product A Intro -> Comparison B -> Comparison C -> Comparison D -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a beauty-focused recommendation guide, specifically highlighting 'dupes' or more affordable alternatives to popular high-end makeup and body care products. By showing the premium item alongside its budget-friendly counterpart with prices displayed in New Taiwan Dollars (NT$), the creator provides viewers with practical shopping advice. The fast-paced editing and upbeat music create a sense of discovery and excitement, while the alternating shots of the creator posing with the items add a personal endorsement and lifestyle appeal.
